script.title: APPEALING A PARKING TICKET
script.scene_zh: 市政辦公室 · 申訴罰單
script.story_hook: Appealing a parking ticket at the city front desk.
script.intro_zh: 在市政辦公室櫃台申訴一張停車罰單。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, everyone! Today: fighting a parking ticket politely.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來，各位！今天我們來有禮地申訴停車罰單。
script.outro: Hope that ticket disappears. Keep listening and see you next time!
script.outro_zh: 希望那張罰單順利消失。持續練習聽力，我們下次見！
script.practice_intro_en: Now it's your turn: read each line with me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在換你跟著我，一句一句朗讀。

script.youtube_description_en:
Got a parking ticket that feels unfair? This 18-line counter conversation teaches you to explain a broken meter, show photo proof, point out the wrong time and a hidden sign, and ask about the hearing date. Natural American English with IPA and translation, then repeat every line out loud in the second half.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🅿️罰單申訴英文｜計費器故障・時間誤差・看板遮擋｜聽完就會申訴｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
明明計費器壞了，卻收到停車罰單？
不服的話，第一線櫃台該怎麼開口？

這一集帶大家走進市政辦公室的櫃台，司機拿出罰單與照片，向櫃員說明計費器離線、時間對不上、告示牌讓樹遮住的疑點，一路問到申訴表格、費用與聆訊安排，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🧾 提出疑點：例如「the meter was broken」、「the ticket says eight fifty」。
📷 展示證據：例如「I took a photo of the screen」、「my dashboard clock at nine」。
📮 詢問流程：例如「is there a fee to appeal?」、「a hearing date by mail」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次再收到罰單，別慌，先用英文申訴看看！
script.thumbnail_action: showing a parking ticket across the counter

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I need help with this parking ticket.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ nid hɛlp wɪð ðɪs ˈpɑrkɪŋ ˈtɪkət/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我需要協助處理這張停車罰單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, hand it over. What's the problem?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr hænd ɪt ˈoʊvər wʌts ðə ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 好，先遞給我看看。問題是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, the meter was broken. I couldn't pay at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðə ˈmitər wəz ˈbroʊkən aɪ kʊdənt peɪ ət ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，計費器壞掉了，我根本沒辦法付款。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, did you take a photo of the screen?
dialogue.phonetic: /həm dɪd ju teɪk ə ˈfoʊtoʊ əv ðə skrin/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那你有拍下螢幕畫面的照片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, right here, plus my dashboard clock at nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs raɪt hɪr plʌs maɪ ˈdæʃˌbɔrd klɑk ət naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 有，就是這張，還有我儀表板的時鐘顯示九點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, this helps. When did you park?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ðɪs hɛps wɛn dɪd ju pɑrk/
dialogue.zh: 好的，這很有用。你幾點停的車？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Around nine. The ticket says eight fifty.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈraʊnd naɪn ðə ˈtɪkət sɛz eɪt ˈfɪfti/
dialogue.zh: 大約九點，但罰單上寫的卻是八點五十。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right. Did you try paying with the app instead?
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt dɪd ju traɪ ˈpeɪɪŋ wɪð ði æp ɪnˈstɛd/
dialogue.zh: 了解。那你有試過改用 App 繳費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I did, but it said the zone was offline.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dɪd bət ɪt sɛd ðə zoʊn wəz ˌɔfˈlaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 試過，但它顯示那個區域是離線的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we have a case. Please fill out this form.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi hæv ə keɪs pliz fɪl aʊt ðɪs fɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 這樣我們就有申訴的道理了。請填這張表。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will do. Um, is there a fee to appeal?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl du ʌm ɪz ðɛr ə fi tə əˈpil/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。呃，申訴要繳費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No fee for a first appeal, don't worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ fi fɔr ə fɜrst əˈpil doʊt ˈwɜri/
dialogue.zh: 第一次申訴不用錢，請別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. Also, that sign was half hidden by a tree.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt ˈɔlsoʊ ðæt saɪn wəz hæf ˈhɪdən baɪ ə tri/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。還有，那塊告示牌有一半讓樹遮住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, that's useful too. Please mention it right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæts ˈjusfəl tu pliz ˈmɛnʃən ɪt raɪt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 哦，那一點也很有用。請在這裡寫明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. What happens after I hand this in?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt wʌt ˈhæpənz ˈæftər aɪ hænd ɪs ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 知道了。那我交回去之後會怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You'll get a hearing date by mail, about a month.
dialogue.phonetic: /jul ɡɛt ə ˈhɪrɪŋ deɪt baɪ meɪl əˈbaʊt ə mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 大約一個月後，你會收到掛號信通知聆訊日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. Do I need to show up in person?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ du aɪ nid tə ʃaʊ ʌp ɪn ˈpɜrsən/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not always. Good luck, I hope they drop it.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈɔlˌweɪz ɡʊd lʌk aɪ hoʊp ðeɪ drɑp ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 不一定。祝你好運，希望他們撤銷這張單子。
